recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not remove BiologicallyDerivedProduct.collection.sourceOrganization or its organization search parameter under FHIR-51939; handle any future concern about that parameter under FHIR-56179 or a new OO decision.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 to replace BiologicallyDerivedProduct.collection.source with distinct collection.sourcePatient and collection.sourceOrganization elements, update HCT examples to sourcePatient, replace the old source search parameter with patient, and add BiologicallyDerivedProduct to the patient compartment via collection.sourcePatient.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3717 and commit 7e1bd58e5366e7d630afee29458031a4b32818eb applied the seed by splitting the StructureDefinition element, updating allogeneic/autologous HCT examples, changing BiologicallyDerivedProduct-collection-source to BiologicallyDerivedProduct-collection-sourcePatient with code patient, adding BiologicallyDerivedProduct to the common clinical patient search parameter, and adding the patient compartment row entry.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini and the inspected XML files are current build source. The current source no longer contains the old collection.source element or source search parameter. The remaining organization search parameter was added later by Applied/Persuasive FHIR-56179 in HL7/fhir#4046 / commit 27bd95ec53c3ba23fcbd3acd1ad2b1443b206be2, and FHIR-56179 comments accepted the build's code organization rather than source-organization.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The seed request is complete in current source, and the apparent mismatch from the original FHIR-51939 resolution text is explained by the later FHIR-56179 decision to add the sourceOrganization search parameter.
